name: Sprints
instructions: On a track or flat straightaway, start from a staggered stance and accelerate as fast as possible over the chosen distance, typically 40 to 400 meters.
Drive your knees high, pump your arms aggressively, and maintain a forward lean during acceleration before transitioning to an upright sprinting posture at top speed.
Walk or jog back to the start to recover fully between reps. Sprints build explosive power and are one of the most time-efficient forms of cardio conditioning.
